rapport_notes: Patient throughout a long, meandering 18-minute call with a disorganized customer; acknowledged the price objection with understanding rather than pushing back.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A – no concern was raised by the customer during discovery (agenda question was never asked); her question about item wrapping was answered directly and wasn't a discovery concern to dig into
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'Ultimately ma'am, on move day, if the move goes faster than what we have anticipated, of course you pay less' and 'this is just an estimate and we only factored in a little extra time in the quote based on the details that we have discussed'

top_strength: Built a fully personalized, itemized estimate that named back nearly every specific item and location detail the customer had given (safe, two fridges, statue, garage, backyard, storage unit, two-story house).
coaching_note: The price landed as a surprise because differentiators (coverage, on-time guarantee, meet-your-mover) were bundled into one long monologue right before the number instead of being used earlier to build value — by the time the $2,910 came out the customer had no time to buy into the reasoning before objecting.
